analysis.purpose: The engine for the agent-authored semantic layer: it decides WHAT still needs describing, hands out grounded work batches, and validates and persists what an agent writes back — without ever calling a model itself.
responsibilities: Rank and hand out enrichment targets across the symbol/file/cluster/system layers
Gate the symbol queue by architectural importance so full coverage is reachable
Pack each batch against a token budget rather than a fixed item count
Reject any authored claim whose evidence quote does not appear in the code it cites
Persist artifacts content-addressed, and report staleness against the live graph
Resolve a target purpose by inheritance when the target itself has none

businessRules.rule: The server never calls a model; the host agent authors, and this module only queues and validates.
businessRules.rationale: Keeps query latency and cost deterministic and makes the graph reproducible.

businessRules.rule: An artifact is only verified when at least one evidence quote overlaps the span it is anchored to; ungrounded claims are rejected as hallucination.
businessRules.rationale: This is the moat that keeps authored prose traceable to real code.

businessRules.rule: Symbol targets below the importance percentile are excluded from the queue but still inherit prose from their file or cluster.
businessRules.rationale: Makes "done" reachable without leaving the excluded tail unexplained.

nodes.name: Semantic authoring loop
nodes.summary: Queue, ground, validate and persist agent-authored meaning.

edges.rationale: This file implements the whole enrichment loop.
